# Experiment C: seasonal exposure (generated by `exp_seasonal.py`)

Scopes: strict = 455 pickups / 29 customers (champion seasonal stage); wide = 4,669 / 217 (component test, champion = production seasonal formula).

C-cap chosen on dev: **180** days (60 = production). Rolling picks: 2018 60, 2019 90, 2021 90, 2022 90, 2023 180, 2024 180, 2025 180, 2026 180. Odd→even picks: 2018 60, 2022 180, 2024 180, 2026 180.
